User Agreement
1. Acceptance of Terms: Before registering, logging in, or using our services, users should carefully read and agree to all terms of this agreement. By registering or using our services, you are deemed to have fully understood and accepted this agreement.
2. Account Registration and Management: Users must ensure that all information provided is true, accurate, and complete. Any changes should be updated promptly. Users may not impersonate others to register accounts.
3. User Rights and Obligations: Users have the right to use all services provided by the platform and are obliged to comply with national laws, regulations, and this agreement. Users must not use the platform for any illegal or prohibited activities.
4. Service Content and Changes: The platform reserves the right to adjust, change, or terminate part or all of the services based on actual operations, and will notify users in advance via announcements or internal messages.
5. Personal Information Protection: The platform strictly protects users' personal information in accordance with the Privacy Policy and will not disclose it to third parties without user authorization.
6. Intellectual Property: The intellectual property rights of the platform and related content belong to the platform. Users may not use, copy, or distribute without authorization.
7. Disclaimer: The platform is not responsible for service interruptions or data loss caused by force majeure, network failures, or third-party reasons.
8. Breach Handling: If users violate this agreement or relevant laws and regulations, the platform has the right to suspend or terminate services and reserves the right to pursue legal responsibility.
9. Modification and Interpretation: Any modifications or updates to this agreement will be announced in advance. If users disagree, they may stop using the services. The final interpretation right belongs to the platform.
login.privacy_policy_content:
Privacy Policy
1. Information Collection: We collect necessary personal information during user registration and service usage, including but not limited to name, contact details, and device information.
2. Information Use: The collected information is only used to provide and optimize services and ensure account security, and will not be used for unrelated purposes.
3. Information Sharing and Disclosure: Without user consent, we will not disclose personal information to any third party, except as required by law or regulatory authorities.
4. Information Storage and Protection: We use various security technologies and management measures to protect user information from loss, misuse, or alteration.
5. User Rights: Users have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal information and may exercise these rights through customer service.
6. Cookies and Similar Technologies: To enhance user experience, we may use cookies and similar technologies to collect and store information, which users can manage or delete.
7. Protection of Minors: If you are a minor, please use our services under the guidance of a guardian.
8. Policy Changes: Any updates to the privacy policy will be notified to users via platform announcements.
9. Contact Us: If you have any questions about the privacy policy, please contact us through official channels.
